camel_example: aliyun rds DescribeBackupTasks --region cn-hangzhou --BackupJobStatus NoStart --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --BackupMode Automated --BackupJobId 4760000 --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --Flag '无'
description_en: Queries the backup tasks of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的备份任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-backup-tasks --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --flag '无' --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --backup-job-id 4760000 --backup-mode Automated --backup-job-status NoStart --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupTasks

parameters.help_en: Specifies the client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup task
parameters.name: backup_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated
Manual
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
The status of the backup task. Valid values:

NoStart
Progressing

By default, this operation returns backup tasks in both states
parameters.help_zh:
备份任务状态，取值：
NoStart：未开始
Progressing：正在进行中

默认为所有状态
parameters.name: backup_job_status

BackupId.description_en:
The ID of the backup set that is generated by the backup task.

If the value of the BackupStatus parameter is Finished, you can view the backup set ID only if you configure the BackupJobId parameter
BackupId.description_zh:
任务生成的备份集ID。
当返回参数BackupStatus为Finished后，传入请求参数BackupJobId才能够查看到备份集ID

BackupJobId.description_en: The ID of the backup task

BackupProgressStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup program. Valid values:

NoStart
Preparing
Waiting
Uploading
Checking
Finished
BackupProgressStatus.description_zh:
备份程序状态。取值：
NoStart：未开始
Preparing：准备中
Waiting：等待中
Uploading：上传中
Checking：检查中
Finished：已完成

BackupStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup task. Valid values:

NoStart
Checking
Preparing
Waiting
Uploading
Finished
Failed

This parameter is returned only after a backup task is run
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份任务状态。取值：
NoStart：未开始
Checking：检查备份
Preparing：准备备份
Waiting：等待备份
Uploading：上传备份
Finished：完成备份
Failed：备份失败

有任务执行时才会返回本参数

JobMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated
Manual
JobMode.description_zh:
备份模式，取值：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

Process.description_en: The progress of the task in percentage

TaskAction.description_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

TempBackupTask: The backup task is an adhoc backup task.
NormalBackupTask: The backup task is a common backup task
TaskAction.description_zh:
任务类型，取值：
TempBackupTask：临时备份任务
NormalBackupTask：普通备份任务
